statement.title: We began as a typesetter. Now the whole press is yours.
statement.text: Write the book, set its pages, draw the cover, order a proof and sell the copies from one room, without passing files between five tools.

steps.title: How a Small Book Is Made at Quillmoor
steps.text: The whole way from outline to bound copy, in one workroom.

items.title: What is the book about?
items.text: Begin with a sentence or paste a manuscript. Chapters and contents are kept in order as you go.

items.title: Set the Pages in One Pass
items.text: Choose a face, a size and a margin. Read the proof on screen before a single copy is printed.

items.title: Hold the First Copy
items.text: Order one proof, check it by daylight, then print as many as the launch needs.

features.title: What is in the workroom?
features.text: Everything between an idea and a parcel of books: writing, setting, a cover, a proof, a page to sell from.
